title: Tailwise Pharmacy Shipping Fees, Free-Shipping Thresholds and Transit Times
content:
Shipping figures for one-time Tailwise Pharmacy orders differ by class. This table gives the standard shipping fee, the same-day subtotal that waives it, the adult-signature requirement and its fee, and the promised transit time.

| Class | Standard pharmacy shipping fee per one-time shipment | Free-shipping threshold (same-day combined pharmacy merchandise subtotal) | Adult signature required on delivery | Adult-signature fee per shipment | Transit days promised after dispensing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | $4.95 | $49.00 | No | $0.00 | 2 days |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | $4.95 | $49.00 | No | $0.00 | 2 days |
| Rx Prescription Diet | $4.95 | $49.00 | No | $0.00 | 4 days |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | $4.95 | $49.00 | No | $0.00 | 2 days |
| Rx Controlled Substance | $4.95 | $49.00 | Yes | $5.50 | 2 days |
| Rx Compounded Medication | $9.95 | $99.00 | No | $0.00 | 3 days |

## Definitions

- **Standard pharmacy shipping fee**: the standard shipping fee per one-time pharmacy shipment below the threshold.
- **Free-shipping threshold**: the same-day combined pharmacy merchandise subtotal at or above which the standard shipping fee is waived.
- **Adult signature required**: whether the carrier must collect an adult signature on delivery.
- **Adult-signature fee**: the fee per shipment requiring an adult signature.
- **Transit days**: transit days promised for a one-time pharmacy order after dispensing.

## Points of reading

- A subtotal of exactly $49.00 meets the $49.00 threshold; $48.99 does not.
- Rx Compounded Medication carries both the higher fee, $9.95, and the higher threshold, $99.00.
- Only Rx Controlled Substance shipments need an adult signature, with a $5.50 fee per shipment.
